payload.title: File:Fossilized tooth of Tiger Shark 6214.jpg
payload.description_html: Fossilized tooth of tiger shark, 18mm x 16mm, washed from Miocene cliffs along the Potomac River, Westmoreland State Park, Virginia. Oblique illumination with 13 watt Ott desk lamp with diffuser and a sheet of white paper used for shadow fill. Nikon D7000, micro-Nikkor 55mm f/3.5 PC AI @ f/16, ISO 100, -2EV, 8 sec for each of two images focus-stacked with CombineZP (macro: Do Stack).
